def test_digitSum():
    # Empty string returns 0
    assert digitSum("") == 0

    # Single uppercase character
    assert digitSum("A") == 65

    # All uppercase characters
    assert digitSum("abcde") == 0
    assert digitSum("ABCDE") == 65 + 66 + 67 + 68 + 69

    # Lowercase only contributes nothing
    assert digitSum("aBcD") == 66 + 68

    # Mixed case with digits and spaces (non-letters contribute 0)
    assert digitSum("Hello World") == ord('H') + ord('W')

    # String with numbers and punctuation
    assert digitSum("123!@#") == 0

    # Uppercase with special characters
    assert digitSum("aA1!Z") == ord('A') + ord('Z')

    # Repeated uppercase characters
    assert digitSum("ZZZ") == 3 * ord('Z')

    print("All tests passed!")
